clue.text: To co-operate take part in a game before social function

indicators.note: says the first piece comes ahead of the second in the answer

parts.note: to play is to take part in a game
a ball is a formal dance, a social function

explanation.surface: An invitation to join a game and then attend a party afterwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To play ball is an idiom for agreeing to work along with others rather than obstruct them.

clue.text: Food fish situation, reportedly

indicators.note: as reported, so it is a word that sounds the same that is entered

parts.note: a place is a situation or location

explanation.surface: A news item on the state of the fish supply.
explanation.definitionFit: Plaice is a flatfish commonly eaten in Britain, notably with chips.

clue.text: Help a lama out, being top dog

indicators.note: letters that are out of place need to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Helping out a Tibetan monk makes one the boss.
explanation.definitionFit: An alpha male is the dominant member of a group, the top dog.

clue.text: Bold manner of a daughter in good show!

indicators.note: the short pieces go inside the cheer

parts.note: bravo is a cry of 'good show!'

explanation.surface: A daughter's confident performance draws applause.
explanation.definitionFit: Bravado is a show of boldness or swagger meant to impress.

clue.text: Permission to pull out

explanation.surface: Someone asks if they may withdraw.
explanation.definitionFit: Leave is both consent given and the act of going away.

clue.text: Is standing next to alluring Scottish castle

indicators.note: says one piece sits right beside the other in the answer

parts.note: glam, short for glamorous, means alluring
taken as written

explanation.surface: An attractive Scottish castle stands beside something, like a tourist brochure line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Is' is not a verb linking definition to wordplay; it supplies the last two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Glamis Castle in Angus is famous from Macbeth and as the childhood home of the Queen Mother.

clue.text: Greek character welcoming a dance

indicators.note: taking someone in, so the letter goes inside the Greek letter

parts.note: lambda is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek person inviting someone to dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Greek character' sounds like a person, but it is a letter of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: The lambada is a fast Brazilian partner dance popular around 1990.

clue.text: Staff set out fruit

parts.note: to staff is to man, as in man the desk
to go is to set out on a journey

explanation.surface: Employees lay out fruit on display.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Staff' and 'set out' are verbs here, not the workers and their display.
explanation.definitionFit: A mango is a sweet tropical stone fruit.

clue.text: Monitor, up in the air, repositioned playpens?

indicators.note: the letters are moved into new positions

explanation.surface: A parent watching over toddlers, with the playpens moved around.
explanation.definitionFit: A spy plane is an aircraft used for surveillance, monitoring from the sky.

clue.text: Problem caused by a cold potato dish — colcannon, primarily

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
rosti is a Swiss fried potato dish

indicators.note: first of all, so the opening letter

explanation.surface: Indigestion from a cold potato dish, colcannon above all.
explanation.walkthrough: Colcannon is an Irish mash of potato and cabbage; only its first letter is used.
explanation.definitionFit: An acrostic is a word puzzle, so a problem in the sense of a brain-teaser.

clue.text: Fee charged by celebrity in show, Loot?

parts.note: an appearance is a showing, turning up in public
loot is slang for money

explanation.surface: A star's fee for a show is sneered at as mere loot.
explanation.definitionFit: Appearance money is the payment a famous person receives simply for turning up at an event.

clue.text: Absurd act of cleaner forced male to leave

parts.note: a char, or charwoman, is a British word for a domestic cleaner

indicators.note: the male's letter departs from the word for forced

parts.note: made means forced, as in 'made him go'

explanation.surface: A cleaner pushes a man out of the room in some ridiculous scene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to leave' removes the male's letter from the word for forced. A char is a British term for a cleaning woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A charade is a pretence so obvious it is ridiculous, an absurd piece of play-acting.

clue.text: Having sustained success playing ace part picked up

parts.note: a show that is on is playing
A is the abbreviation for ace in cards

indicators.note: heard, so the word for part is replaced by one sounding the same

parts.note: a role is an actor's part

explanation.surface: An actor in a play enjoys a winning streak after being given an ace part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picked up' means heard: ROLE gives the same-sounding ROLL.
explanation.definitionFit: To be on a roll is an idiom for enjoying a run of good luck or wins.

clue.text: In-law got disorientated in sleeping car

indicators.note: a confused, disoriented set of letters is rearranged

explanation.surface: A relative by marriage gets lost on a train's sleeping car.
explanation.definitionFit: A wagon-lit is a European railway carriage with berths for overnight travel.

clue.text: Let loose dress down, inferior to large one

indicators.note: in a down answer the inferior piece sits below, so these come above

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing
I is the Roman numeral one
to dress down is to scold, to berate

explanation.surface: Fashion advice: wear something casual, smaller than one large size.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dress down' means scold, not wear casual clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: To liberate is to set free, release from confinement.

clue.text: Parish priest, losing head, may give serious offence

indicators.note: the first letter of the word for the priest is dropped

parts.note: a parson is a parish priest

explanation.surface: A clergyman going crazy might commit a grave sin.
explanation.definitionFit: Arson, deliberately setting fire to property, is a grave crime.

clue.text: Religious ceremony after southern song

indicators.note: places the religious ceremony behind the southern letter

parts.note: pi, short for pious, means religious
a ritual is a ceremony

explanation.surface: A church rite held after a song from the South.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Religious ceremony' reads as one phrase but gives two pieces, and 'after' puts both behind the southern letter; the definition is 'song' at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A spiritual is a religious folk song from the African American tradition.

clue.text: Violent argument between family and household servant?

definitions.meaning: informal for a violent quarrel at home

explanation.surface: A family row that turns on the maid.
explanation.definitionFit: Domestic as a noun covers both a home dispute and a house worker.

clue.text: Evident across mouth of Thames

parts.note: over means across, as in 'over the river'

indicators.note: the mouth is the river's start in clue terms, so its first letter

explanation.surface: Something visible across the estuary of the Thames.
explanation.definitionFit: Overt describes something done openly and plainly visible, not hidden.

clue.text: Name it, English insect

parts.note: a term is a name for something
taken as written

explanation.surface: A challenge to identify an English insect.
explanation.definitionFit: A termite is a wood-eating social insect.

clue.text: Hide dollars given by family

parts.note: bucks is slang for dollars
kin are one's family

explanation.surface: Someone conceals cash handed over by relatives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hide' looks like a verb but is the noun, an animal's skin.
explanation.definitionFit: Buckskin is leather made from the skin of a deer, a kind of animal hide.

clue.text: Wise man perhaps describing French duke's wolf

indicators.note: in its sense of drawing round, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: a seer is a prophet, one kind of wise man
duc is French for duke

explanation.surface: A sage depicting a French nobleman as a wolf.
explanation.definitionFit: A wolf is slang for a womaniser who preys on women, a seducer.

clue.text: This may be classified stuff about social worker

indicators.note: surrounding, so one piece goes round the other

parts.note: to wad is to stuff or pad
an ant is a social insect and a worker

explanation.surface: A confidential file about a social worker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'classified' suggests secrecy, but means listed in the classified ads; the ant is the social worker.
explanation.definitionFit: A want ad is a small newspaper advertisement found in the classified section.

clue.text: Ruler exercises right in capital after revolution

indicators.note: the two short pieces go inside the other
turned round, so the city's name is read backwards

parts.note: Rome is a capital city
PE, physical education, is school exercises

explanation.surface: A ruler working out in a capital after an uprising.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after revolution' turns the city round to EMOR, and 'in' puts the exercises and right inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An emperor is the sovereign head of an empire, its supreme ruler.

clue.text: All right to enter for each game

indicators.note: goes into, so this piece sits inside the other

parts.note: per means for each, as in per person
OK means all right

explanation.surface: It's fine to sign up for every game.
explanation.definitionFit: Poker is a card game of betting and bluffing.

clue.text: Admire a new dessert wine

indicators.note: a new version of these letters is a reshuffled one

explanation.surface: Praise for a novel sweet wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Madeira is a fortified wine from the Portuguese island, often drunk with dessert.

clue.text: Had in mind low temperature

parts.note: mean means low or base in character

explanation.surface: Someone was thinking of a cold spell.
explanation.definitionFit: Meant is the past tense of mean, to intend, so had in mind.

clue.text: Consider of interest old story put on hold

indicators.note: the later pieces are set onto the end of the word for hold

parts.note: to take is to grab hold of
to be into something is to be interested in it
an account is a story or narrative of past events

explanation.surface: Weighing up an interesting old tale that has been postponed.
explanation.definitionFit: To take something into account is to allow for it when making a judgement, to weigh it.

clue.text: Move swiftly along in pursuit

definitions.meaning: to rush along fast and uncontrolled
a ... is one's occupation or pursuit in life

explanation.surface: Something rushing forward in a chase.
explanation.definitionFit: Career as a verb means hurtle; as a noun it is a profession one follows.

clue.text: Caused a surprise to begin with — went to the front

parts.note: to start is to begin
led means was in front, at the head

explanation.surface: A runner who sprang an early surprise by taking the lead.
explanation.definitionFit: Startled means gave someone a sudden shock or fright.
